```python
def merge_intervals(intervals):
    if not intervals:
        return []
    
    # Sort intervals based on their start times
    sorted_intervals = sorted(intervals, key=lambda x: x[0])
    merged = [sorted_intervals[0].copy()]
    
    for interval in sorted_intervals[1:]:
        last = merged[-1]
        if interval[0] <= last[1]:
            # Merge the intervals by updating the end of the last interval
            new_end = max(last[1], interval[1])
            merged[-1][1] = new_end  # Modify in place to avoid creating new list each time
        else:
            merged.append(interval.copy())
    
    return merged
```
